_comment: Copy to targets.json (gitignored) and list the companies you actually want to work for. ATS/company career endpoints for the companies source. type is the ATS platform: greenhouse | lever | ashby | workday | oracle | statejobsny. token is the company's slug on that platform (find it in the careers-page URL). title_filter is a case-insensitive regex applied to posting titles; wide boards need one, small security shops can omit it and take everything. The self-building list (answer file J: employers scoring >70) appends here with added_by:'auto'.
title_filter_default: secur|cyber|soc |soc-|network|threat|incident|infosec|information technology|help desk|desktop support|systems admin|sysadmin|it analyst|it specialist|noc |grc|penetration|vulnerab
